title: Wgpu Window Rail Paint Parity
description: Fix WGPU renderer so per-window Command (engagement) and Window Options (measures) foldable rails are visible (paint on overlay list) and match React placement, default fold state, and visibility gating.
summary: Follow-up fix for WGPU window rails: (1) overlay chip clicks were stolen by the window scroll-region hit registered later — chip hits are now registered after render_window_content; (2) engagement visibility gating incorrectly hid the Command chip — React always shows the chip when engagement exists, only the body is gated — collapsed chip now always renders, engagement_activated drives expand/collapse; (3) render_chrome_group gained register_hits flag so overlay chips skip duplicate/wrong control_ids.
